_comment: wave 40 (windowed array constructors batch 4: whole-temporal merge, by-value span array, and gap-aware sequence-set build). Three array-make folds extending the wave 16/23/24 family. (1) temporal_merge_array collects a window of temporal VALUES fed as hex-WKB literals, parses each via temporal_from_hexwkb into a Temporal* pointer array, merges, and emits the result as hex-WKB (fold=tempmergearray). (2) spanset_make collects a window of span literals into a CONTIGUOUS Span value array (parse via intspan_in, memcpy into arr[i], free the parsed heap span), builds the SpanSet, and serializes via intspanset_out (fold=spansetmake, by-value variant). (3) tsequenceset_make_gaps collects a window of temporal-instant literals (parse via tgeompoint_in cast to TInstant*), builds a TSequenceSet* with FIXED interp/maxt/maxdist baked into the finalize, and emits hex-WKB (fold=tseqsetmakegaps). All input_shape=tnumber with the VARSIZED value field, value_type_guard relaxed.

operators.comment_one_liner: temporal_merge_array (Temporal *) - the temporal merged from a window of temporal values (hex-WKB).
operators.value_type_msg: value must be a temporal hex-WKB literal; timestamp must be numeric

operators.comment_one_liner: spanset_make (SpanSet *) - the span set built from a window of span values.
operators.value_type_msg: value must be a span literal; timestamp must be numeric

operators.comment_one_liner: tsequenceset_make_gaps (TSequenceSet *) - the gap-aware sequence set built from a window of temporal-instant values (hex-WKB).
operators.value_type_msg: value must be a temporal-instant literal; timestamp must be numeric
